worldcombat.skill.dragonhammer.summary: The user wields its whole body like a hammer, swinging it down onto a single target: on impact the target is hurled along the swing and left knocked down, barely able to move for a while. Heavy swings harder and keeps the target pinned longer; Swift is faster and knocks foes farther.
worldcombat.skill.dragonhammer.use.0: Knock a charging target down and cut its movement
worldcombat.skill.dragonhammer.use.1: Land one heavy Dragon-type contact hit on a single target
worldcombat.skill.dragonhammer.use.2: Break a foe's chase rhythm at close quarters
worldcombat.skill.dragonhammer.use.3: Hurl a target away to make room for allies
worldcombat.skill.dragonhammer.descripti: The whole body is swung down for about %1$s Dragon-type contact damage at a reach of about %2$s blocks. The foe's Defence, type matchups and critical hits are settled on impact.
On a hit the target is hurled about %1$s blocks along the swing and knocked down for about %2$s seconds, moving far slower.
worldcombat.skill.dragonhammer.heavy.on: Heavy on: about ×1.15 power, ×1.3 knockdown and ×0.8 knockback, +3 ticks prepare and +8 ticks cooldown, pinning the target in place.
worldcombat.skill.dragonhammer.heavy.off: Heavy off (Swift): about ×1.25 knockback, ×1.1 reach and a faster prepare, at about ×0.9 power and a shorter knockdown.
worldcombat.skill.dragonhammer.timing: Cast at a target within %1$s blocks; after a %2$s-second prepare it spends %4$s PP, then recovers %3$s seconds; cooldown %5$s seconds from commit.
worldcombat.skill.dragonhammer.growth.0: At level %1$s, hammer power rises to %2$s.
worldcombat.skill.dragonhammer.preferenc: On: about ×1.15 power, ×1.3 knockdown and ×0.8 knockback, +3 ticks prepare and +8 ticks cooldown, pinning the target in place. Off (Swift): about ×1.25 knockback, ×1.1 reach and a faster prepare, at about ×0.9 power and a shorter knockdown.
The companion only swings while a target is within this distance; farther targets are left to the shared approach logic.
Not already knocked down skips foes still lying on the ground, saving the swing for a target that is still standing.
